page.overview:
Who is Kamanue?

Kamanue was a short young man of pale skin complexion. His face was decorated by a thick dark-green line that ran under his eyes and across his nose, stretching vertically on his forehead to form a horizontal line. Four large dots were also placed on his face: one at each end of the line on his cheeks, one in the middle of his forehead, and a final one below his lower lip.

His eyes were cat-like in shape, the pupils slit and the irises pale blue with a white ring around the sides. The kanji for |Ka}} and the daiji for |Roku}} was etched onto his left eye, which signified his position. Kamanue also possessed dark brown hair with bright orange tips, which he wore swept back but fluffed out on either side of his head and neck. He wore a white haori with a yellow scale pattern down the sleeves, as well as a white button-up shirt and dark hakama pants.

Kamanue was a very anxious and restive individual. He constantly wore a scared expression due to the fact that he felt weak and vulnerable as the lowest of the Lower Ranks. He appeared to be constantly skittish during his short time at the Infinity Castle.

As with most demons, his loyalty to Muzan Kibutsuji, though steadfast, was built on great fear. He sweated profusely when he heard the Demon King's voice. Frozen in terror, he was unable to say a word when Muzan questioned his loyalty and challenged him to continue speaking.
